sources.title: France's Bardella faces new allegations of anti-Semitic comments
Bardella's antisemitic messages: 19 elements proving he was the author, contrary to his denials
French actor Gerard Depardieu to face trial for rape, court rules

en.title: Bardella faces new anti-Semitic allegations Depardieu faces rape trial
en.dek: French leader Jordan Bardella faces new anti-Semitic allegations while actor Gerard Depardieu is set for a rape trial
facts: French leader Jordan Bardella faces new allegations of anti-Semitic comments on 26 November 2026
Le Monde obtained a 2013 Facebook conversation involving Bardella
French actor Gerard Depardieu will face trial for allegedly raping Charlotte Arnould in 2018
A Paris appeal court upheld the decision for Depardieu to face criminal trial on 26 November 2026
body: French media published extracts from previously unaired conversations on 26 November 2026, which presented new allegations against Jordan Bardella, the 31-year-old ally of Marine Le Pen; Le Monde stated that 19 elements in a private 2013 Facebook conversation matched Bardella's authorship, despite his denials.
French actor Gerard Depardieu, 77, will face trial for allegedly raping actress Charlotte Arnould in 2018, because a Paris appeal court ruled on 26 November that his bid to avoid trial failed.
The Paris appeals court ruled that Depardieu would be tried for the alleged rape on 7 August 2018, although it dismissed a second alleged rape on 13 August 2018.
en.context: Arnould first accused Depardieu of rape in 2018, stating the assaults occurred in his Paris home when she was in her early 20s.

zh.title: 巴尔德拉面临新的反犹太主义指控 德帕迪厄将面临强审判
zh.dek: 法国领导人巴尔德拉面临新的反犹太主义指控，而演员德帕迪厄将面临强审判
facts: 法国领导人巴尔德拉面临新的反犹太主义指控
《世界报》获取了一份2013年的涉及巴尔德拉的Facebook对话
法国演员德帕迪厄将面临2018年强奸指控的审判
巴黎上诉法院维持了对德帕迪厄进行刑事审判的决定
body: 法国媒体于2026年11月26日公布了此前未播出的对话摘录，其中提出了针对海洋·勒庞31岁盟友乔丹·巴尔德拉的新指控。《世界报》称，尽管巴尔德拉否认，但私人2013年Facebook对话中的19个元素与他的笔迹相符。
法国演员热拉尔·德帕迪厄（Gerard Depardieu）今年77岁，将因涉嫌在2018年强奸女演员夏洛特·阿诺尔德（Charlotte Arnould）而面临审判，此前巴黎上诉法院于11月26日裁定他规避审判的请求失败。
巴黎上诉法院裁定，德帕迪厄将就2018年8月7日的涉嫌强奸案接受审判，但驳回了关于2018年8月13日另一起涉嫌强奸案的指控。
zh.context: 阿诺尔德于2018年首次指控德帕迪厄强奸，称袭击发生在他在巴黎的家中，当时她还是二十出头。

problemsFixed: The headline uses a semicolon which is not permitted for drama or separation in a factual statement.
The dek is too long and contains evaluative framing ('denies').
The facts list contains unsupported dates (September 2026 for Bardella allegations, as S1 only mentions Thursday, 26/11/2026).
The context section uses evaluative framing ('why this is happening').
The structure does not adhere to the required rhythm (varying sentence length, no four short declarative sentences in a row).
The opening of the body paragraphs does not start with the actor, number, or date.
The body paragraphs are too dense and lack the required sentence variation.
